title: Simple Passive Totem
description: Automatically activates Totem of Undying effect whenever you're about to die — no totem needed in hand or inventory. Works in all modes including Hardcore.
body:
# Simple Passive Totem

> **Makes you impossible to die in Minecraft — no totem needed in hand or inventory!**

Simple Passive Totem automatically activates the Totem of Undying effect whenever your health reaches 0. No need to hold a totem, no need to keep one in your inventory — just install and you're protected.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🛡️ **Automatic protection** — activates when health reaches 0, no input required
- ❤️ **Health restored** to 1 heart instantly
- 🎆 **Totem visual effect & sound** still plays
- 🔄 **Spammable** — no cooldown, nearly impossible to die
- 🎮 **Works in all modes**, including Hardcore
- 🔧 **Toggle with** `/passive totem true/false`

---

## ⚠️ Side Effects

| Effect | Duration | Level |
|--------|----------|-------|
| 🕶️ Blindness / Darkness | 1 second | I |
| 🍗 Hunger | 2 seconds | I |

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the `.jar` file for your Minecraft version
2. Move the file to your `mods/` folder
3. Make sure **Fabric API** is installed
4. Launch the game — you can't die!

---

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/passive totem` | Check current status |
| `/passive totem true` | Enable passive totem |
| `/passive totem false` | Disable passive totem |

---

## 🧩 Best For

- Hardcore mode
- PvP & PvE
- Challenge maps / parkour
- Players who don't want to lose progress

---

## 📋 Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|-------------|---------|
| Minecraft | Match mod version |
| Fabric Loader | 0.16.10+ |
| Fabric API | Match mod version |

---

MIT

# Bahasa Indonesia

> **Mustahil mati di Minecraft — tanpa perlu totem di tangan atau inventory!**

Simple Passive Totem secara otomatis mengaktifkan efek Totem of Undying setiap kali health kamu mencapai 0. Tidak perlu memegang totem, tidak perlu menyimpannya di inventory — cukup install dan kamu terlindungi.

---

## ✨ Fitur

- 🛡️ **Perlindungan otomatis** — aktif saat health mencapai 0, tanpa input apapun
- ❤️ **Health dipulihkan** ke 1 hati secara instan
- 🎆 **Efek visual & suara** Totem of Undying tetap muncul
- 🔄 **Bisa di-spam** — tidak ada cooldown, hampir mustahil mati
- 🎮 **Bekerja di semua mode**, termasuk Hardcore
- 🔧 **Toggle dengan** `/passive totem true/false`

---

## ⚠️ Efek Samping

| Efek | Durasi | Level |
|------|--------|-------|
| 🕶️ Blindness / Darkness | 1 detik | I |
| 🍗 Hunger | 2 detik | I |

---

## 📦 Cara Instalasi

1. Download file `.jar` sesuai versi Minecraft kamu
2. Pindahkan file ke folder `mods/`
3. Pastikan **Fabric API** sudah terpasang
4. Jalankan game — kamu tidak bisa mati!

---

## 🔧 Command

| Command | Keterangan |
|---------|-----------|
| `/passive totem` | Cek status saat ini |
| `/passive totem true` | Aktifkan passive totem |
| `/passive totem false` | Nonaktifkan passive totem |

---

## 📋 Requirements

| Kebutuhan | Versi |
|-----------|-------|
| Minecraft | Sesuai versi mod |
| Fabric Loader | 0.16.10+ |
| Fabric API | Sesuai versi mod |
